"""Build a cover page + minimal report body and merge them into report.pdf."""
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# --- Helvetica widths (1/1000 em) for accurate centering ---
W = {'A':667,'B':667,'C':722,'D':722,'E':667,'F':611,'G':778,'H':722,'I':278,
     'J':500,'K':667,'L':556,'M':833,'N':722,'O':778,'P':667,'Q':778,'R':722,
     'S':667,'T':611,'U':722,'V':667,'W':944,'X':667,'Y':667,'Z':611,
     'a':556,'b':556,'c':500,'d':556,'e':556,'f':278,'g':556,'h':556,'i':222,
     'j':222,'k':500,'l':222,'m':833,'n':556,'o':556,'p':556,'q':556,'r':333,
     's':500,'t':278,'u':556,'v':500,'w':722,'x':500,'y':500,'z':500,
     ' ':278,',':278,'.':278,'-':333,'0':556,'1':556,'2':556,'3':556,'4':556,
     '5':556,'6':556,'7':556,'8':556,'9':556}

def text_width(s, size):
    return sum(W.get(c, 500) for c in s) * size / 1000.0

def build_pdf(objects):
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode()
        out += obj
        out += b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    n = len(objects) + 1
    out += f"xref\n0 {n}\n".encode()
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        out += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()
    out += (f"trailer\n<< /Size {n} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
            f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n").encode()
    return bytes(out)

def make_page_pdf(content_bytes, fonts):
    """fonts: dict of resource name -> BaseFont, e.g. {'/F1': '/Helvetica-Bold'}"""
    font_objs = []
    for name, base in fonts.items():
        font_objs.append(
            f"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont {base} >>".encode())
    res = "<< /Font << " + " ".join(f"{n} {i+4} 0 R" for i, n in enumerate(fonts)) + " >> >>"
    stream = b"<< /Length " + str(len(content_bytes)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n" + content_bytes + b"\nendstream"
    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
        + res.encode() + b" /Contents " + str(4 + len(fonts)).encode() + b" 0 R >>",
    ]
    objects.extend(font_objs)
    objects.append(stream)
    return build_pdf(objects)

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
DATE = "August 02, 2026"

# ---- Cover page ----
w_title = text_width(TITLE, 30)
w_date = text_width(DATE, 18)
x_title = (612 - w_title) / 2.0
x_date = (612 - w_date) / 2.0
cover_content = f"""BT
/F1 30 Tf
{x_title:.2f} 480 Td
({TITLE}) Tj
ET
BT
/F2 18 Tf
{x_date:.2f} 430 Td
({DATE}) Tj
ET
{x_title - 20:.2f} 458 m
{x_title + w_title + 20:.2f} 458 l
2 w S
""".encode()

with open("cover.pdf", "wb") as f:
    f.write(make_page_pdf(cover_content, {"/F1": "/Helvetica-Bold", "/F2": "/Helvetica"}))

# ---- Minimal report body (placeholder, since report.pdf did not exist) ----
body_content = f"""BT
/F1 20 Tf
72 720 Td
({TITLE}) Tj
ET
BT
/F2 12 Tf
72 690 Td
(Prepared on {DATE}) Tj
ET
BT
/F2 11 Tf
72 640 Td
(Placeholder report body. Replace this content with the actual report) Tj
72 622 Td
(before publishing. The cover page above was added as page one.) Tj
ET
""".encode()
with open("body.pdf", "wb") as f:
    f.write(make_page_pdf(body_content, {"/F1": "/Helvetica-Bold", "/F2": "/Helvetica"}))

# ---- Merge: cover page first, then body -> report.pdf ----
reader_cover = PdfReader("cover.pdf")
reader_body = PdfReader("body.pdf")
writer = PdfWriter()
for p in reader_cover.pages:
    writer.add_page(p)
for p in reader_body.pages:
    writer.add_page(p)
writer.add_metadata({
    "/Title": TITLE,
    "/Subject": "Annual Financial Report with cover page",
    "/Creator": "pdf skill",
    "/CreationDate": "D:20260802120000Z",
})
with open("report.pdf", "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print("Created cover.pdf, body.pdf, and merged report.pdf")
EOF
echo "pdf done"
